The as-built run obeyed its contract - metadata-builder Step 5 rule 1 forbids writing an element it cannot copy from the inventory - and still produced an undeployable file. The guardrail against fabrication is working; it is not a guardrail against a thin library, and this step is the clearest evidence of that distinction the build has produced so far.
